items.question: What do you think about living in the city centre?

people.name: Lucy
people.text: I live in a small flat in the centre. I walk to work in ten minutes, so I don't need a car. But my street is very noisy at night and my windows are old. Sometimes I can't sleep. Next year I want to move to a quieter street.

people.name: Omar
people.text: I love the centre because there are so many shops and cafés. My favourite place is the old market on Saturdays. The problem is the price. Rents are very high, so I share a flat with two friends.

people.name: Elena
people.text: I grew up in the centre, but now I live in a village near the city. We have a garden, and our children can play outside. I drive to work and it takes forty minutes. It is tiring, but I would not change my life.

people.name: Jack
people.text: I work in the centre, but I live outside it. I go by train, and I read a book on the way. The centre is great for work, but at weekends I like green places. I walk in the hills with my dog.

statements.text: This person goes to work on foot.

explanation.en: Lucy says she walks to work in ten minutes.
explanation.es: Lucy dice que va andando al trabajo en diez minutos.

statements.text: This person lives with other people because housing is expensive.

explanation.en: Omar says rents are very high, so he shares a flat with two friends.
explanation.es: Omar dice que los alquileres son muy altos, así que comparte piso con dos amigos.

statements.text: This person has a long journey to work every day.

explanation.en: Elena drives to work and it takes forty minutes. Jack does not say how long his train journey is.
explanation.es: Elena conduce al trabajo y tarda cuarenta minutos. Jack no dice cuánto dura su trayecto en tren.

statements.text: This person is planning to move to another home.

explanation.en: Lucy wants to move to a quieter street next year. Elena says she would not change her life.
explanation.es: Lucy quiere mudarse a una calle más tranquila el año que viene. Elena dice que no cambiaría su vida.

statements.text: This person reads while travelling to work.

explanation.en: Jack goes by train and reads a book on the way.
explanation.es: Jack va en tren y lee un libro por el camino.

statements.text: This person enjoys visiting a market once a week.

explanation.en: Omar's favourite place is the old market on Saturdays.
explanation.es: El sitio favorito de Omar es el mercado antiguo los sábados.

statements.text: This person's children can play in a garden.

explanation.en: Elena says they have a garden and their children can play outside.
explanation.es: Elena dice que tienen jardín y sus hijos pueden jugar fuera.

items.question: What is the best way to learn English?

people.name: Maria
people.text: I study English with an app for twenty minutes every day. It is cheap, and I can use it on the bus. But I am shy about speaking, and the app can't answer my questions. I want to find someone to practise with.

people.name: Ben
people.text: I like a real classroom. I enjoy meeting other students, and my teacher gives us games to play. After class we sometimes have a coffee together. I tried online lessons last year, but I got bored.

people.name: Aisha
people.text: I work all day and I have two young children, so I can't go to a school. I have a video lesson with a teacher on Sunday evenings. She corrects my mistakes, and I pay less than I would pay at a school.

people.name: Pedro
people.text: I learn English by watching films and series. At first I used Spanish subtitles, but now I use English ones. It is fun, and I have learnt many new words. The only problem is that I never practise writing.

statements.text: This person studies in short sessions on a phone.

explanation.en: Maria uses an app for twenty minutes every day, even on the bus.
explanation.es: Maria usa una aplicación veinte minutos al día, incluso en el autobús.

statements.text: This person would like more chances to speak English with someone.

explanation.en: Maria says she is shy and wants to find someone to practise with.
explanation.es: Maria dice que le da vergüenza hablar y quiere encontrar a alguien con quien practicar.

statements.text: This person likes to meet classmates after the lesson.

explanation.en: Ben says they sometimes have a coffee together after class.
explanation.es: Ben dice que a veces toman un café juntos después de clase.

statements.text: This person can't study at a school because of a busy family life.

explanation.en: Aisha works all day and has two young children, so she can't go to a school.
explanation.es: Aisha trabaja todo el día y tiene dos hijos pequeños, así que no puede ir a una escuela.

statements.text: This person's teacher tells them when they make mistakes.

explanation.en: Aisha says her teacher corrects her mistakes.
explanation.es: Aisha dice que su profesora le corrige los errores.

statements.text: This person has learnt new words from entertainment.

explanation.en: Pedro watches films and series and says he has learnt many new words.
explanation.es: Pedro ve películas y series y dice que ha aprendido muchas palabras nuevas.

statements.text: This person does not practise one of the English skills.

explanation.en: Pedro says he never practises writing.
explanation.es: Pedro dice que nunca practica la escritura.
